nonadditivity_audit.conclusion: The residuals prove network-level non-additivity for these frozen runs; module-count non-monotonicity alone does not prove it, and none of the deltas is causal attribution.

findings.title: The exact/shared moment-reciprocal hardware direction is labeled admitted without hardware evidence
findings.evidence: M266 executes a Python coefficient-output substitution only. Its own runtime receipts say moment_finalizer_modeled=false and m266_rtl_exists=false, and the producer boundary excludes RTL, VCS, DC, speedup, energy and PPA. The accuracy result rejects the tested Q20N2 approximation, but it does not establish that one shared exact moment/reciprocal engine is the optimal or admitted hardware architecture.
findings.required_fix: Relabel hardware_direction.admitted as a design recommendation/hypothesis. Admit only the accuracy conclusion that the tested approximate coefficient path is unsafe without recovery; require a service-demand, buffering, utilization, RTL and Synopsys comparison before admitting sharing.

findings.title: The producer's stated non-additivity rationale is incomplete
findings.evidence: Stage2 approximating more modules than stage1 while having a smaller regression establishes non-monotonic sensitivity, not mathematical non-additivity. Independent recomputation gives the actual evidence: M263 all24 is +1.108332%, whereas the four disjoint stage-run deltas sum to +2.932801% and BN1+BN2 sum to +4.084177%, leaving -1.824469 and -2.975845 percentage-point residuals.
findings.required_fix: Add the all24-versus-partition residual table and state precisely that stages are pairwise disjoint, BN1/BN2 are disjoint, and the two partition families cross-classify the same modules. Keep all deltas non-causal.

findings.title: The maximum local-error gate cannot be independently recomputed from retained payloads
findings.evidence: The sealed receipts retain sum_abs, sum_squared, output population and a reported maximum. Mean and RMSE recompute exactly, but no raw per-hook/per-channel maxima or delta trace is retained, so the maximum values from 4.768e-5 to 1.125e-4 are evaluator receipts rather than independently reconstructed observations.
findings.required_fix: Retain a compact per-hook maximum/error checksum ledger, or qualify the maximum gate as receipt-verified while keeping only mean/RMSE independently recomputable.

findings.title: The raw ep35 checkpoint cannot be rehashed locally
findings.evidence: All 27 copied remote payloads and all 34 local-manifest rows verify, and their hashes agree. Of the three input_identity rows, the evaluator and config exist and rehash locally; the 591 MB checkpoint is absent. Its 4f33... identity is bound by the remote receipt/manifest but cannot be independently reconstructed on this server.
findings.required_fix: Preserve the remote execution identity qualification, and either transfer the checkpoint or keep an independently signed remote sha256 receipt. Do not say all raw inputs were locally rehashed.

findings.title: The required minimal fallback-set conclusion needs tested-granularity wording
findings.evidence: Every tested nonempty approximate subset fails the AEE gate, including each four-module stage subset. Thus the only accuracy-admitted choice among these six coarse options is to keep all 24 FFN BN coefficient paths exact/high precision. The data do not exclude a finer per-module subset, calibration or QAT recovery.
findings.required_fix: State explicitly: all 24 remain exact/high precision at the tested subset granularity; finer fallback selection is unknown pending module-level or trained evidence.

claim_boundary.permitted: Exact six-subset first-ten zurich_city_09_a paired AEE, DSEC-Fl and spike sensitivity; sealed aggregate local-error evidence; exact target/hook population; and non-additivity residuals against frozen M263 all24.
claim_boundary.forbidden: valid825/general accuracy, causal stage attribution, a trained mixed-precision network, raw local-max independent proof, an admitted shared hardware architecture, RTL/VCS/DC, speedup, energy, system, paper-PPA or headline claims.
